preamble: Devoicing of the palatalized voiced stop [dʲ] to [tʲ] keeps the secondary palatal articulation while neutralizing voicing. It is best documented in Russian, where word-final obstruents and obstruents before voiceless consonants are devoiced, so final /dʲ/ surfaces as [tʲ] and contrasts with the voiced form only before a vowel.

examples.note: Word-final devoicing of the palatalized dental stop; the soft sign keeps the palatalization.
Final [tʲ] alternates with voiced [dʲ] before a vowel, as in genitive груди́.

sources: Wikipedia contributors (2025). Russian phonology: Final devoicing. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_phonology
